title: Angels Landing: 17 deaths on one trail #Shorts
description:
At least seventeen people have died at Angels Landing in Zion. The last half mile follows a spine of rock with sheer drops on both sides. We climbed it in 2021. Many of the falls didn't happen on the chains at all.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 1: Zion's Deadliest Day): https://youtu.be/Hlr80lyDlwA

#Shorts #AngelsLanding #Zion #Hiking
